rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits high melanin saturation, approximately 90-95% dark pixel distribution across the visible apex, with minimal lighter/pinkish pixelation concentrated near the lower nasal margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced gape revealing four intact canines and a complete set of upper and lower incisors; significant skin folding (rugae) on the muzzle due to extreme facial contraction.
